messages:
Maya K: Quick post-incident follow-up from yesterday's log-access incident. TL;DR — a service account had overly broad RBAC and pulled audit logs. Containment: disabled account + rotated credentials. We need owners for RCA tasks, backlog tickets, and tabletop follow-ups.

Jon P: I can own RBAC cleanup. I'll enumerate exact roles to remove and the scoped roles to add.

Samir R: I'll take KMS rotations and key policy review. Which keys were used for logging?

Maya K: Logging keys: `projects/logging-key-1` (prod) and `projects/metrics-key` (prod). Samir please rotate prod logging key and tighten key IAM (no owner-level binds on keys). Target due Mon 2026-04-01. @sec-bot: add a detection rule for high-volume reads.

sec-bot: Created detection rule `audit.log_read_high_volume` -> triggers on >1000 read operations/day by a single principal. Test window: 72h.

Emily S: I'll update the runbooks — incident playbook, detection tuning, and the comms template. ETA Wed 2026-03-31.

Leo T: Recommend adding an immutable sink for suspicious access: replicate logs to an immutable bucket with retention lock for 7 days while investigation runs. I can prototype S3 lifecycle + retention lock. Assign to me, target Apr 7.

Jon P: RBAC plan: create scoped role `auditor-read-only` with least privilege (logs.viewer + specific list), rotate service accounts using that role, and add a deny policy for dangerous perms like `resourcemanager.projects.delete`. I'll open a PR and ask for review. Target Fri 2026-03-28.

Maya K: Scheduling a tabletop: 60-min run on Fri 2026-04-03 10:00 PT. Agenda: detection cadence, rapid rotation play, and comms. Volunteers: Jon, Samir, Emily, Leo. @all please confirm.

Samir R: Confirmed. I'll bring the KMS rotation checklist and scripts.

Emily S: :thumbsup: Confirmed — I'll draft the scenario and post to #incidents so SRE can join.

Jon P: Quick question — do we want to increase audit log retention from 90 -> 180 days for prod? Will add cost estimate to the PR.

Maya K: For now keep retention at 90. Priority is access controls + immutable backup for investigations. Include cost estimate in PR so product/finance can weigh in.

Leo T: Creating Jira tickets now: SEC-3581 (RBAC scoped role + replace service accounts), SEC-3582 (KMS rotate + key policy update), SEC-3583 (Runbook updates + tabletop), SEC-3584 (Immutable log bucket prototype). I will link branches and PRs.

sec-bot: Tickets created: SEC-3581, SEC-3582, SEC-3583, SEC-3584.

Maya K: Final ask: please add a short blameless RCA note (2-3 sentences) to SEC-3585 (RCA writeup) by Tue 2026-03-30. We'll compile for the postmortem and customer comms.

Emily S: Adding mine now.

Samir R: Will add technical timeline + mitigation steps.

Jon P: I'll attach PRs to SEC-3581 when they are ready.

Maya K: Thanks all. Leaving thread open for blockers. I'll draft the customer-facing comms template early next week and circulate for review.
